name: Gabapentin
summary: An anticonvulsant that binds the α2δ subunit of voltage-gated calcium channels, used mainly for neuropathic pain, postherpetic neuralgia, and focal seizures.
mechanism: Binds the α2δ subunit of presynaptic voltage-gated calcium channels, reducing calcium influx and excitatory neurotransmitter release.

pharmacokinetics.bioavailability: Dose-dependent (~60% at 300 mg, declining as dose rises due to saturable absorption)
pharmacokinetics.onset: Days to weeks for neuropathic pain effect
pharmacokinetics.metabolism: Minimal; largely renal excretion of unchanged drug

dosing.adult: Start 300 mg once daily, titrate to 300 mg TID; epilepsy typically 900–1800 mg/day in 3 divided doses
dosing.renalAdjustment: Required — reduce dose proportionally to CrCl (e.g., CrCl <60 mL/min)

safety.pregnancy: Limited data; not clearly teratogenic — use only if clearly needed
warnings: Dizziness and somnolence — falls risk, especially in the elderly
Abrupt discontinuation can precipitate withdrawal seizures — taper
Respiratory depression when combined with opioids or other CNS depressants, especially with renal impairment, COPD, or in the elderly
Class warning: suicidal thoughts and behavior
monitoring: Fall risk and sedation in elderly patients
safety.overdose: Drowsiness, dizziness, ataxia; supportive care; hemodialysis can remove the drug

indications: Neuropathic pain (e.g., diabetic peripheral neuropathy — off-label)
clinicalPearls: Absorption is saturable — doubling the dose does not proportionally raise plasma levels; keep TID dosing
Not metabolized and virtually free of CYP interactions — a clean add-on in polypharmacy, but always dose for renal function
good: Neuropathic pain or focal seizures when a non-metabolized, interaction-free add-on is needed in a patient on many drugs.
bad: Renal impairment without dose adjustment, or when rapid onset matters — effect builds slowly over weeks.

provenance.notes: Curated from standard neurology/pharmacology references. Values omitted where not confidently known — nothing invented.
